# I-19 — The pre-push hook of a linked worktree runs the main checkout's tools, so it checks the worktree's generated files against the wrong `core/`

**Status:** ⬜ · **Agent:** C1 · **Size:** 1 SP · **Area:** Git rules · **Reported:** —

**The pre-push hook of a linked worktree runs the main checkout's tools**: `core.hooksPath` is an absolute path to `tools/git-hooks` of the main checkout, and `tools/git-hooks/pre-push` finds `harness.mjs` beside itself (`$here/../harness.mjs`). A push from a linked worktree (`.claude/worktrees/*`, where every worker of a flow runs) therefore runs the main checkout's `harness.mjs`, which compares the worktree's generated skills (`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`) with the main checkout's `core/procedures`. A branch that changes a procedure fails the push although `harness check generated` passes in the worktree. The worker of step 1 of flow 2 (task 2.7, pull request #146) met it and pushed with `git -c core.hooksPath=<the worktree>/tools/git-hooks push`, the same hook run from the worktree's own tools. A fix: the hook resolves `harness.mjs` from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` (the worktree's own tree) instead of its own location, with a test that pushes from a linked worktree whose procedure differs from the main checkout's. Found by the worker of step 1 of flow 2.
